title: Stock Market News Scraper input
description: Collect US stock market news from Bloomberg, MarketWatch, and Yahoo Finance RSS feeds. Filter by ticker (AAPL, TSLA), company name, or keywords. Set includeKeywords to [] to disable the default finance keyword filter. Use feedPreset custom for non-US RSS feeds.

feedPreset.title: Feed preset
feedPreset.description: Curated RSS feed bundle. us_markets = MarketWatch + Yahoo + Bloomberg (default). custom = use feeds array for any region.
feedPreset.sectionDescription: Select a preset feed bundle or provide your own RSS/Atom URLs.

feeds.title: Custom feeds
feeds.description: RSS or Atom feed URLs. Used only when Feed preset is "custom". Each item can be a URL string or an object with name and url.

tickers.title: Stock tickers
tickers.description: Only include articles mentioning these tickers (e.g. AAPL, TSLA, NVDA). Works together with includeKeywords unless includeKeywords is []. Leave empty to disable ticker filter.
tickers.sectionDescription: Narrow results by ticker, company name, or keywords.

companies.title: Company names
companies.description: Only include articles mentioning these company names. Leave empty to disable.

tickerMatchMode.title: Ticker match mode
tickerMatchMode.description: When multiple tickers are set: "any" keeps articles matching at least one ticker; "all" requires every ticker.

includeKeywords.title: Include keywords
includeKeywords.description: Only include articles where the headline or summary contains at least one keyword. Use an empty array to disable.

excludeKeywords.title: Exclude keywords
excludeKeywords.description: Exclude articles where the headline or summary contains any of these keywords.

maxItems.title: Maximum items
maxItems.description: Maximum news items returned after sorting by publishedDate descending.

maxItemsPerFeed.title: Max items per feed
maxItemsPerFeed.description: Optional cap on items kept from each individual feed before global sorting. Leave empty for no per-feed limit.

hoursBack.title: Hours back
hoursBack.description: Only include articles published within this many hours. Use 0 to disable the date filter.
hoursBack.sectionDescription: Date range, deduplication, and network settings.

deduplicate.title: Deduplicate by link
deduplicate.description: Remove duplicate articles that appear in multiple feeds.

feedRetries.title: Feed retries
feedRetries.description: Number of retries after the first failed attempt for each feed.
